subject: MSD-001 final: Ziggy's voice decisions folded in (both cues; women's voices)
body:
Ziggy answered the two open voice items, and I have folded them into a final file.

Decisions, in his words this session: voice in BOTH cues; the voice is women's voices, multiple and may differ ("can be different - multiple"). He named the order he means by a franchise name, which enters nothing; I carried only the idea — a ritual order of women, several voices, intoning in an invented tongue of no real language, never a melody that carries the piece, no syllables written out.

Final file: `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/music_scoring_department/returns/deepseek/MSD-001_20261102T205105Z.md`
bytes 9322, sha256 `e20e7da40060e942803492d0a09c5d8b46aaff78e22551af19e972c525781ecc`.

What changed from my 20:32 return (which stays unchanged on disk): the sandworm prompt now carries the voices at row 2 only (under the tracks converging, silent from the rise onward, the man on the dune's tone stays instrumental); the vault prompt carries them at rows 2–5 (ladder down through the climb, stopping at the door, the release wordless); the tower stays instrumental. The do-not list in each now carries the voice line in place of "no vocals": "no words of any real language, no lyric, no sung melody, no imitation of any singer or of any score's vocal style; the voices never carry the piece". The vault's one remaining variant is the tick out. Nothing else changed; the rhythm phrase, the register (baritone), and the endings are as before.

Nothing generated, submitted or edited. No music service, provider or tool is named.

-- Deep_SEEK
